description: Get detailed contractor profile by slug. Returns full profile including about text, website, and trade details. The website is null when none is stored or when the stored value is not the business's own site (a directory, social or government page). Phone and email are returned only to callers with an API key; without one they are null and contact_details is requires_api_key. A customer key gets the phone but not the email (contact_details is phone_only). is_verified is true only when the contractor's license passed a check against a state board record.
name: get_contractor
title: Get Contractor Profile
